title: South Carolina BEAD: four of eight remaining agreements are signed; construction remains prospective
publisher: South Carolina Office of Regulatory Staff
summary: South Carolina reports that eight of the original 16 BEAD projects moved to non-BEAD funding, four of the eight remaining provider agreements were signed, and the remaining BEAD scope covers 19,022 locations and $35.802 million. Denominator: Eight remaining BEAD providers after the state moved eight original projects to other funding; 19,022 remaining broadband-serviceable locations.
key_findings: Finding: South Carolina reports that eight of the original 16 BEAD projects moved to non-BEAD funding, four of the eight remaining provider agreements were signed, and the remaining BEAD scope covers 19,022 locations and $35.802 million.
